title: DecisionFlag
description: A decision that genuinely belongs to the human — cost, risk appetite, scope, or a fork the agent cannot resolve from the request, the data, or sensible defaults. Only raise a flag the human truly must answer; anything the agent can recommend, it recommends instead of flagging. Enforces Principles 4 and 9.

owner.description: Who must decide (a name or role).

question.description: The decision, as a single concrete question.

why_yours.description: Why this cannot be a default the agent picks — it turns on cost, risk tolerance, scope, or private preference the agent cannot infer.

deciding_fact.description: The one fact that would make a person choose this option.

options.description: The real options, each with the single fact that would flip the choice. Not an exhaustive survey.

recommendation.description: The agent's recommended option and the one-line reason. A flag without a recommendation is a punt.

blocking.description: True if work cannot proceed until answered; false if the agent proceeded on a default and this is confirmable later.

default_taken.description: If non-blocking, the default the agent proceeded on pending an answer.
